note: entries drawn in list order, not the fixed paint order, so an inside stroke listed before an overlay is painted under it, caught by StyleCompositeTests.paintOrderIsFixed
fill opacity applied to effects, so a glow under a layer at fill opacity 0 vanishes with it, caught by StyleCompositeTests.fillOpacityFadesOnlyTheLayer
overlay not clipped to alpha, so a colour overlay floods the whole buffer and adds alpha outside the layer, caught by StyleCompositeTests.overlayStaysInside

layer composited src-over onto knocked-out under layers, so a lone drop shadow or outside stroke is lighter at the edge than the single effect, caught by StyleCompositeTests.loneShadowAndOutsideStrokeEqualTheEffect
replacement: sum[i] = src[i] * stack.fillOpacity + sum[i] * (1 - src[i - i % 4 + 3] * stack.fillOpacity)

note: entry mode ignored in compositeClipped, so a Multiply overlay draws as Normal, caught by StyleCompositeTests.multiplyOverlayMultipliesTheOneBelow
anchor: try onto.composite(layer.source, x: 0, y: 0, mode: layer.mode, opacity: layer.opacity)
replacement: try onto.composite(layer.source, x: 0, y: 0, mode: .normal, opacity: layer.opacity)

note: under-layer mode ignored, so a Screen glow over a drop shadow draws as Normal, caught by StyleCompositeTests.screenGlowOverShadowDiffersFromNormal
anchor: try canvas.composite(under.source, x: 0, y: 0, mode: under.mode, opacity: under.opacity)
replacement: try canvas.composite(under.source, x: 0, y: 0, mode: .normal, opacity: under.opacity)

note: zero-width style stroke layer draws the anti-aliased edge, caught by StyleCompositeTests.zeroWidthStrokeZeroBevelAndClearOverlayAreIdentity
anchor: guard strokeWidth > 0 else { return try PixelBuffer(width: width, height: height) }
replacement: guard strokeWidth >= 0 else { return try PixelBuffer(width: width, height: height) }
